card.name: Small words before expected next phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, of, at, have) and commas inside stock label phrases, where the next words are highly predictable. Examples are 'within 14 days of stopping an MAOI' and 'may be at greater risk'.

modes.label: Linking word in stock phrase
modes.description: A short word such as of, at, the or have sits just before a well-known label phrase continues.
modes.example: Do not use escitalopram tablets within 14 days<< of>> stopping an MAOI intended to treat psychiatric

modes.label: Comma in drug list
modes.description: A comma after a drug class inside a list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: Thiazides and other diuretics, corticosteroids, phenothiazines, thyroid products, estrogens, oral contraceptives<<,>> phenytoin, nicotinic
